title: Told After Supper
author: Jerome K. (Jerome Klapka) Jerome
longDescription: Jerome is a collection of humorous ghost stories written during the late 19th century. This work captures the festive spirit of Christmas Eve as it explores the tradition of telling ghost stories among friends and family during this time.

authorInfo.bio: Jerome K. (Jerome Klapka) Jerome (1859–1927) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Three men in a boat (to say nothing of the dog). The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
